jobs.title: Legal Engineering Program Manager
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As a Program Manager for the Legal Engineering organization, you will be joining Harvey's Legal Engineering organization to drive the operational infrastructure that enables one of the company's fastest-growing GTM functions to scale effectively. The Legal Engineering team partners directly with the world's leading law firms and professional services providers to deploy AI-powered solutions, and this role ensures that the programs, processes, and systems underpinning the team operate with rigor and consistency. You will partner with Legal Engineering managers, Sales Operations, Product, and leadership to translate strategic priorities into executable programs that drive measurable outcomes. It is a rare opportunity to build program management from the ground up within a high-growth function at the intersection of AI and legal services.





WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and execute end-to-end programs that support the Legal Engineering team's operational rhythm.

 - Build and maintain the processes, tooling, and documentation that enable Legal Engineering managers to operate consistently across regions (US, EMEA, APAC).

 - Drive change management initiatives as the Legal Engineering organization scales, ensuring smooth adoption of new processes and tools.





WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 4–7 years of experience in program management, operations, or enablement within a high-growth technology or professional services environment.

 - Demonstrated ability to design and deliver cross-functional programs from concept through execution, managing multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.

 - Strong communication and facilitation skills with the ability to influence without authority across a distributed organization.

 - Experience with change management, process design, and operational scaling in fast-paced environments.

 - Comfort with ambiguity and a bias toward action—able to build structure where none exists and iterate quickly.

 - Familiarity with GTM functions, legal technology, or AI products is a strong plus.





COMPENSATION

$155,100-$232,700 USD

 - 3+ years of people management experience required. A nice to have would be prior experience managing managers as well.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; you're energized by working across teams and can bring people together around shared goals

 - Demonstrated ability to be an effective business partner and lead a team of business partners, with the ability to build trusted relationships, navigate diverse working styles, and influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

As Harvey grows, we’re taking on increasingly complex, cross-functional programs that cut across teams and require dedicated end-to-end ownership. These range from opening new entities and markets, to M&A and integration work, to evolving the systems and providers that support our employees around the world.



You’ll run point on some of our key operational initiatives: bringing structure to ambiguous problems, building the plan, coordinating work across functions, and driving decisions and execution.



This is a hands-on program management role — you’ll work closely with functional experts, but you’re expected to get into the substance, develop a point of view, and personally step into gaps wherever needed to drive the program forward.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own complex, high-priority programs from initial planning through execution and handoff, including M&A initiatives spanning diligence through integration, geographic expansion and entity formation, and major operational transitions.

 - Build and drive the program plan, translating a messy objective into clear requirements, workstreams, owners, dependencies, readiness gates, and decisions; proactively surface risks, resolve blockers, and adjust the plan as facts change.

 - Connect the dots across functions. Partner deeply with People, Recruiting, Finance, Legal, Tax, IT, and other teams to understand how decisions in one workstream affect another, identify gaps before they become problems, and make sure the right people are involved at the right moments.

 - Build repeatable infrastructure as we scale, turning what we learn from each program into better templates, SOPs, playbooks, and operating processes for the next one.

 - Drive critical decisions forward. Develop a point of view, frame tradeoffs, bring the right stakeholders together, and ensure decisions translate into execution.

 - Own program communication and change management, from crisp executive updates and decision points to clear, thoughtful communications for employees affected by a change.

 - Keep the employee experience at the center. Make sure operational complexity behind the scenes translates into a coordinated, thoughtful experience for employees — particularly during high-change moments like integrating a new team, entering a new market, or transitioning employment infrastructure.





WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 7+ years of experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in fast-moving environments, including meaningful experience supporting M&A transactions and integrations across multiple stages of the lifecycle

 - A hands-on operating style and strong bias toward action. You dig into the substance, step into gaps, and do what’s needed to keep complex work moving. You’re comfortable figuring things out as you go and have good judgment about what requires deeper diligence versus what simply needs to get done.

 - Strong stakeholder management and judgment, with the ability to align specialists and senior leaders across functions without formal authority.

 - Clear, direct executive communication. You can distill a complicated program into the decisions, risks, and tradeoffs that matter and communicate them appropriately to everyone from executives to affected employees.

 - Strong AI fluency. You use AI as a core part of how you work — to move faster, synthesize information, work through ambiguity, and increase the quality and leverage of your output.




COMPENSATION

$120,000 - $200,000 USD

jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.




ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey ships fast, and our customers tell us constantly what's working and what isn't — through CSMs, support, sales, and early-access programs. Today that signal lives in a hundred places and reaches Product inconsistently, and the systems that let the EPD organization plan, review, and fix things at scale are still being built. You will own those systems: a single Voice of the Customer program that turns scattered feedback into structured, trusted input for every product team; a bug management process that gets defects triaged, prioritized, and resolved predictably; and the operating rhythm that keeps Engineering, Product, and Design aligned. You own the infrastructure and cadence; embedded Product Operations Managers own the interpretation and day-to-day judgment for their product areas.







WHAT YOU'LL DO


VOICE OF THE CUSTOMER PROGRAM

 - Design and stand up the end-to-end feedback pipeline: intake from CS, Support, Sales, and EAPs into one structured system

 - Partner with RevOps to design & implement tooling; define the workflows that make submitting feedback the easy default for field teams

 - Set the weekly triage cadence and SLAs so every piece of signal is classified, routed, and visible

 - Build reporting that Product, GTM, and leadership actually read — volume, themes, trends, and what changed

 - Own the classification model: product area, matter stage, root cause (missing capability, defect, or usability friction)

 - Give Design and Research standing views into the signal that matters to them


PRODUCT OPERATING RHYTHM

 - Design and run the core engineering, product & design rituals: planning cycles, roadmap reviews, design reviews, and monthly business reviews

 - Build the run-of-business systems that scale as Harvey grows — intake frameworks, RACI structures, decision logs, shared calendars

 - Facilitate roadmap planning by coordinating inputs across Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM and maintaining transparency across the org

 - Make it clear across Harvey what EPD is building, how it's progressing, and what's coming next

 - Own the end-to-end bug lifecycle: intake from Support and the field, severity definitions, triage, routing to engineering teams, and resolution tracking

 - Define severity and SLA standards that CS, Support, and Engineering all agree to and can see

 - Run the recurring bug review with engineering and product leads; escalate aging or customer-impacting defects

 - Report bug volume, aging, and resolution trends by product area, and connect defect signal back into the Voice of the Customer taxonomy

 - Close the loop with Support and CS so customers hear when their issue is fixed







WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 5+ years in program management, product operations, or a related operational role at a high-growth tech or SaaS company

 - You've built processes and programs from scratch and scaled them — not just inherited and maintained them

 - Hands-on experience running bug triage or incident/defect management processes across Engineering and Support

 - Experience designing and facilitating product development rituals — planning, reviews, prioritization — with senior engineering and design leaders

 - Deep fluency with feedback, ticketing, and data tooling; you're comfortable owning a taxonomy and the systems that enforce it

 - Ability to translate messy qualitative and quantitative input into clear, structured outputs

 - Proven ability to drive alignment and adoption across CS, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering without direct authority

 - Experience with AI-native or highly technical products is a plus

 - You create clarity where none exists, and you're energized by a blank slate





COMPENSATION

$155,400 - $233,200 USD

Harvey ships fast, and our customers tell us constantly what's working and what isn't — through CSMs, support, sales, and early-access programs. Today that signal lives in a hundred places and reaches Product inconsistently, and the systems that let the EPD organization plan, review, and fix things at scale are still being built. You will own those systems: a single Voice of the Customer program that turns scattered feedback into structured, trusted input for every product team; a bug management process that gets defects triaged, prioritized, and resolved predictably; and the operating rhythm that keeps Engineering, Product, and Design aligned. You own the infrastructure and cadence; embedded Product Operations Managers own the interpretation and day-to-day judgment for their product areas.







WHAT YOU'LL DO


VOICE OF THE CUSTOMER PROGRAM

 - Design and stand up the end-to-end feedback pipeline: intake from CS, Support, Sales, and EAPs into one structured system

 - Partner with RevOps to design & implement tooling; define the workflows that make submitting feedback the easy default for field teams

 - Set the weekly triage cadence and SLAs so every piece of signal is classified, routed, and visible

 - Build reporting that Product, GTM, and leadership actually read — volume, themes, trends, and what changed

 - Own the classification model: product area, matter stage, root cause (missing capability, defect, or usability friction)

 - Give Design and Research standing views into the signal that matters to them


PRODUCT OPERATING RHYTHM

 - Design and run the core engineering, product & design rituals: planning cycles, roadmap reviews, design reviews, and monthly business reviews

 - Build the run-of-business systems that scale as Harvey grows — intake frameworks, RACI structures, decision logs, shared calendars

 - Facilitate roadmap planning by coordinating inputs across Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM and maintaining transparency across the org

 - Make it clear across Harvey what EPD is building, how it's progressing, and what's coming next

 - Own the end-to-end bug lifecycle: intake from Support and the field, severity definitions, triage, routing to engineering teams, and resolution tracking

 - Define severity and SLA standards that CS, Support, and Engineering all agree to and can see

 - Run the recurring bug review with engineering and product leads; escalate aging or customer-impacting defects

 - Report bug volume, aging, and resolution trends by product area, and connect defect signal back into the Voice of the Customer taxonomy

 - Close the loop with Support and CS so customers hear when their issue is fixed







WHAT YOU HAVE

 - You've built processes and programs from scratch and scaled them — not just inherited and maintained them

 - Hands-on experience running bug triage or incident/defect management processes across Engineering and Support

 - Experience designing and facilitating product development rituals — planning, reviews, prioritization — with senior engineering and design leaders

 - Deep fluency with feedback, ticketing, and data tooling; you're comfortable owning a taxonomy and the systems that enforce it

 - Ability to translate messy qualitative and quantitative input into clear, structured outputs

 - Proven ability to drive alignment and adoption across CS, Support, Sales, Product, and Engineering without direct authority

 - Experience with AI-native or highly technical products is a plus

 - You create clarity where none exists, and you're energized by a blank slate





COMPENSATION

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

We’re hiring an experienced, hands-on leader to shape GTM Strategy & Operations for Harvey in APAC. You’ll join the Revenue Operations organization, which serves as the core strategic and business partner to Harvey’s global GTM teams, with a mission to drive sustained, efficient growth and operational excellence. In this role, you’ll own how our APAC field teams turn strategy into disciplined, data-driven execution, from market prioritization to operating cadence and performance management. You will act as a trusted thought partner to APAC Sales Leadership and cross-functional stakeholders, helping connect regional realities to Harvey’s global go-to-market model. It’s a chance to build and scale a high-impact function in a fast-growing, category-defining AI company.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Partner with APAC Enterprise Sales Leadership to define field strategy for APAC and ensure alignment with Harvey’s global GTM operating model, enabling predictable, durable revenue growth across the region.

 - Drive forecast rigor and pipeline quality by establishing clear expectations, processes, and inspection mechanisms that improve CRM hygiene, data accuracy, and visibility into risk and upside.

 - Design, implement, and evolve regional operating rhythms (business reviews, forecast calls, pipeline reviews, planning cadences) that support disciplined execution and scale as the business grows.

 - Lead high-priority GTM initiatives for APAC that tackle complex, cross-functional problems (e.g., territory and coverage design, segmentation, capacity and headcount modeling, market-entry playbooks) and translate them into clear plans for the field.

 - Partner closely with GTM Enablement to identify capability gaps, shape regional enablement priorities, and support the onboarding and ramp of new AEs and SDRs through data-driven insights and feedback loops.

 - Over time, build and develop a high-performing team of APAC Sales Business Partners, setting a high bar on analytical rigor, stakeholder partnership, and operational excellence.

 - Serve as the connective tissue between APAC and global Revenue Operations, sharing learnings, advocating for regional needs, and helping standardize best practices across markets where it makes sense.


QUALIFICATIONS

 - 10+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Strategy & Operations, or a closely related field.

 - Experience in high-growth technology environments combined with backgrounds in investment banking, private equity, venture capital, strategy/management consulting, or similarly analytical roles is strongly preferred.

 - 2+ years of people management experience leading high-performing, analytically oriented teams.

 - Demonstrated track record as a strategic business partner to senior GTM leaders, with the ability to build trust, navigate diverse working styles, and influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills; you are energized by working across Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance, Product, and Enablement to drive toward shared commercial outcomes.

 - Comfort operating in fast-paced, highly ambiguous environments, with a bias toward structured thinking, clear communication, and high-quality execution under time pressure. .




ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

 - Location: Sydney, NSW (Hybrid with flexibility)

 - Work eligibility: Must have valid Australian work rights; Harvey does not currently offer visa sponsorship for this role




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Structured hybrid working arrangement: 3 days in our Sydney office, 2 days working from home

 - Health Coverage: Fully covered private hospital insurance, plus extras for dental, optical, physio, mental health, and more.

 - Family & Fertility Support: Support for fertility treatments, adoption, and surrogacy through Carrot.

 - Retirement & Security: Comprehensive coverage designed to support your long-term well-being.

 - Paid Leave: Paid annual leave, sick leave, and fully paid parental leave for all parents.

 - Wellness & Perks: Daily in-office lunch, wellness memberships through Wellhub, and monthly commuting support.

 - Professional Development: Annual support for courses, certifications, conferences, and books.

 - Remote Work Allowance: Monthly support for home office, internet, and phone expenses.

 - Harvey Holiday: After four years, enjoy a four-week paid sabbatical to rest, travel, or explore new experiences.
